qualifier: eIF2α kinase (HRI, GCN2) and ATF4 arm, including mitochondrial stress
name: eIF2α kinase–ATF4 integrated stress response and translational control
rationale: All members concern stress-induced eIF2α phosphorylation, translational repression and ATF4 output (HRI, GCN2, mitochondrial UPR, ATF4 targets), which separates the theme from confusables built on the ATF6/XBP1/IRE1 ER chaperone arms.

name: Osteoclast formation by macrophage fusion and bone resorption
rationale: Members cover osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, fusion/syncytium formation, DAP12 signaling and bone resorption; the macrophage fusion component distinguishes it from osteoblast, IGF and M-CSF confusables.

name: Lysophospholipid receptor and phospholipase C–IP3 calcium signaling
rationale: Members share PLC-driven phosphoinositide/IP3 production and calcium signaling (G protein, LPA/S1P receptors, VEGFR2), distinguishing it from purinergic, prostanoid/leukotriene, cAMP and PKC-centred confusables.

name: Nucleoside transporters and antiviral nucleoside analogue disposition
rationale: All members concern equilibrative/concentrative transport of purine and pyrimidine nucleosides and bases, including abacavir and ribavirin handling and SLC29A3 defects, unlike confusables centred on nucleotide catabolism, thiopurine metabolism or mitochondrial apoptosis.

name: CHD/NuRD nucleosome remodeling and methylation in transcriptional co-regulation
rationale: Members span nucleosome organization, CHD and NuRD remodelers, arginine/TP53 methylation and transcriptional co-regulators (E2F6, RUNX1), which separates them from BAF/acetylation and DNA-repair/ADP-ribosylation chromatin confusables.

qualifier: pre-initiation through promoter escape, host and HIV promoters
name: RNA polymerase II pre-initiation, initiation and promoter escape
rationale: All members cover Pol II pre-initiation complex assembly, promoter opening, initiation, promoter escape and early elongation complex formation (including the HIV LTR versions), whereas confusables centre on productive elongation, pausing, termination and Tat-mediated HIV elongation.

name: Regulation of leukocyte–endothelial adhesion and extravasation
rationale: Members all regulate leukocyte attachment to vascular/arterial endothelium, adhesion molecule production and extravasation, unlike confusables on inflammatory cytokines, endothelial remodeling, monocyte activation or integrin/PECAM1 cell-cell adhesion.

core: Vesicle targeting and tethering to the Golgi
name: Rab/ARF GTPase–regulated vesicle tethering at the Golgi
rationale: Members concern vesicle targeting/tethering at the Golgi and constitutive secretion together with Rab GAP and ARF signaling, distinguishing the theme from COPI/COPII coat-budding and Golgi-organization confusables.

name: Endolysosomal vesicle fusion and Golgi-to-lysosome delivery
rationale: Members describe fusion of autophagosomes, endosomes, multivesicular bodies and phagosomes with lysosomes plus Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, whereas confusables focus on regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation.

core: Lymphoid organ development and lymphocyte homing
qualifier: mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue and B cells
name: Mucosal and secondary lymphoid tissue development and B cell homing
rationale: Members cover lymph node and MALT/GALT development, marginal zone B cell differentiation, B cell chemotaxis, S1P signaling and lymphocyte entry into lymphoid organs, distinguishing the theme from T cell and dendritic cell chemokine-migration confusables.

core: Lymphocyte antigen receptor signaling and differentiation
qualifier: B and T cell costimulation, thymic selection and germinal center maturation
name: B and T lymphocyte antigen receptor signaling, development and activation
rationale: Members span BCR and TCR signaling, CD28/ICOS/CTLA4/BTLA co-signals, thymic selection, germinal center and plasma cell differentiation and B/T cell signature modules; this mature receptor-driven activation scope separates the theme from confusables focused on early B lineage commitment/V(D)J, NK cells or myeloid identity.

name: IL-12–driven Th1 response and interferon-gamma production
rationale: All members concern IL-12 production and JAK-STAT signaling, IFN-gamma and Th1 cytokine output and Th1/memory T cell promotion, whereas confusables emphasise dendritic cell activation, MHC expression or naive CD4 Th1 differentiation.

qualifier: RAS GAPs and oncogenic RAS/MAP2K/NF1 mutants
name: RAS GAP inactivation and oncogenic RAS–MAPK pathway mutants
rationale: Members cover GAP-mediated RAS inactivation, NF1 loss and RAS GAP/RAS/MAP2K mutant signaling down to RSK, distinguishing the theme from confusables on ERK feedback dephosphorylation or SOS/SHC-driven RAS activation.

name: Lysine acetylation and tubulin glutamylation post-translational modification
rationale: Members concern lysine/N-terminal and histone acetylation together with tubulin acetylation status and C-terminal polyglutamylation/deglutamylation, separating the theme from tubulin folding, histone methylation and protein methylation confusables.

core: Metabolic regulation of glycolysis and pentose phosphate shunt
name: p53 and mTORC1 control of glycolysis and pentose phosphate shunt
rationale: Members tie p53 and mTORC1 programmes to regulation of glycolysis, the pentose phosphate shunt and nucleotide catabolism, distinguishing the theme from HIF, FOXO, NRF2 and fructose-bisphosphate glycolysis confusables.

name: VEGF and Tie2 regulated angiogenesis and endothelial cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover VEGF/VEGFR2, neuropilin and Tie2 signaling, sprouting angiogenesis, endothelial proliferation, fate and arterial/venous/lymphatic specification, distinguishing the theme from BMP-driven cardiac vascular morphogenesis and smooth muscle/shear stress confusables.

name: Negative regulation of NF-κB, TNF signaling and inflammatory cytokines
rationale: All members dampen canonical/non-canonical NF-κB and TNF signaling or IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-family cytokine production, whereas confusables restrain TLR/LPS signaling or IL-10/IL-12/T cell cytokines.

qualifier: flippase/scramblase activity, blebbing and membrane repair
name: Plasma membrane phospholipid flipping, scrambling and membrane repair
rationale: Members concern P4-ATPase flippases, calcium-activated scrambling (ANO6), phospholipid translocation, blebbing, cell volume and membrane repair, distinguishing the theme from apoptotic cell clearance, mechanosensing and ER intermembrane lipid transfer confusables.

name: FGFR-activated PI3K and phospholipase C-gamma cascades
rationale: All members are PI3K or PLC-gamma cascades downstream of FGFR1-4 or phosphatidylinositol signaling, unlike confusables built on FRS/SHC adaptor cascades and ligand binding.

core: Immunoregulatory receptor control of lymphocyte activation
qualifier: NK inhibitory receptors, T cell tolerance and dendritic cells
name: Immunoregulatory receptor control of NK, T and dendritic cell activation
rationale: Members cover KIR/MHC class Ib inhibitory NK receptors, Fc inhibitory signaling, T cell costimulation, anergy and peripheral tolerance and dendritic cell activation, distinguishing the theme from Treg-suppression and NK cytotoxicity-promoting confusables.

name: Hedgehog–Smoothened signaling and GLI-driven transcription
rationale: All members concern Hedgehog ligand-receptor engagement, Smoothened activation and ciliary localization, and GLI target transcription, distinguishing the theme from neural plate, axial mesoderm and planar cell polarity developmental confusables.

qualifier: small RNA biogenesis and AU-rich element-binding proteins
name: Small RNA silencing and RNA-binding protein–directed mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA-mediated silencing plus ARE-binding protein (TTP, AUF1, KSRP, HuR) control of mRNA stability, decapping and 5'-3' decay, unlike confusables on splicing, 3'-end processing or translational control.

qualifier: neuronal target genes and loss-of-function variants
name: MECP2 regulation of neuronal genes and MECP2 dysfunction
rationale: All members concern MECP2 regulation, its control of neuronal ligands, receptors, channels and transcription factors, and loss of its methyl-DNA binding or phosphorylation, distinguishing it from HDAC/NCoR, CREB/CaMK and behavioural confusables.

name: Apoptotic execution: nuclear lamina breakdown and DNA fragmentation
rationale: Members describe late apoptotic nuclear events (lamina breakdown, chromatin condensation, DNA fragmentation) and their regulation, unlike confusables centred on mitochondrial BCL-2 family activation and apoptosome caspase activation.

qualifier: T-dependent germinal center help (Tfh, ICOS, CD27)
name: B cell activation, proliferation and T-dependent germinal center responses
rationale: Members concern B cell activation, proliferation, survival, homeostasis and germinal center formation with Tfh/ICOS/CD27 help and memory, distinguishing the theme from confusables made of B cell/plasma cell expression signatures and immunoglobulin modules.
